summary_zh: Filee 是一款免费开源的文件转换工具，用户按住按键拖拽文件到光标处的格式圆环即可完成转换，支持图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HWP/HWPX、视频、音频、电子书、压缩包等多种类别。转换在本机离线完成，不上传文件，结果保存在原文件旁。
audience_zh: 适合需要频繁批量转换多种格式文件、注重隐私不愿上传文件的普通用户和办公人群，也适合在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上使用图形界面或命令行进行转换的用户。

evidence.quote: Free, open-source file converter. Convert 263 formats offline by drag & drop — images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP/HWPX, video, audio, e-books and archives. No upload, no Office needed.
Hold a key (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS), drag files and drop them on a format in the donut that opens at your cursor.
Filee works offline and saves the result next to the original.
